title: Police investigate fatal Frankston fire

A woman has died following a fire at a Frankston home on Thursday afternoon.

Firefighters were called to a fire at a unit on Stanley Street shortly before 5pm, where a woman was found dead.

Police are yet to determine the cause of the blaze, with an arson chemist to attend the scene.

Police are investigating a fire at a home in Melbourne's south-east that claimed the life of a woman on Thursday afternoon.

Firefighters were called to a blaze at Stanley Street in Frankston just before 5pm.

Crews arrived to find a lower level of a two-storey unit on fire, bringing it under control about half an hour later.

A yet-to-be-identified woman was found dead inside the home.

No one else was inside the property at the time.

Police say the circumstances of the fire are yet to be determined, with a crime scene now in place and an arson chemist to attend the scene.

The investigation remains ongoing.

Anyone who witnessed the incident, with CCTV/dashcam vision or information is urged to contact Crime Stoppers on 1800 333 000 or submit a report online.
